// @path: src/app/ops/schools/page.tsx
// Ops may import ops, by any spelling. The import allowlist resolves relative
// specifiers now rather than skipping them, so this fixture proves the
// resolution allows a sibling module instead of failing every ops tree that
// uses one.
import { requireOperator } from "../../../lib/ops/session";
import { listSchoolsForOps } from "@/lib/ops/reads";
import { SchoolTable } from "./SchoolTable";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function OpsSchools() {
  await requireOperator();
  const schools = await listSchoolsForOps();
  return <SchoolTable schools={schools} />;
}
